\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
Our method replaces the softmax attention with a kernel feature map.

\subsection{Kernelized Attention}\label{sec:kernel}
We approximate $\mathrm{softmax}(QK^\top)V$ with feature maps $\phi(Q)\phi(K)^\top V$,
following~\cite{katharopoulos2020linear}.

\subsection{Complexity Analysis}\label{sec:complexity}
The cost drops from $O(n^2 d)$ to $O(n d^2)$ in the sequence length $n$.
